command:
set -euo pipefail; d=$(find /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'active-*' | sort | tail -1); python3 - "$d/workers.jsonl" <<'PY'
import json,sys,collections,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); seen=set(); n=0
for line in p.open(errors='replace'):
 try:r=json.loads(line)
 except:continue
 key=(r.get('provider'),r.get('model'),r.get('http_status'),r.get('classification'))
 if key in seen:continue
 seen.add(key); n+=1
 body=r.get('error_body')
 print('---',key)
 if isinstance(body,dict): print(json.dumps(body,ensure_ascii=False)[:1800])
 else: print(str(body)[:1800])
 if n>=12:break
PY
